verdict.rationale: Codex CLI supports API key authentication as an alternative to a ChatGPT subscription (codex-gh-4), which would imply usage-based billing, but the docs explicitly steer users toward subscription plans (Plus/Pro/Business/Edu/Enterprise) as the recommended path (codex-gh-3) and note API key setup is more involved. Community evidence also shows the newest flagship model (gpt-5.3-codex) is not yet available via API at all (codex-comm-5), undermining full pay-as-you-go usage.
